title: Georgia school districts
description: Every Georgia county and independent city school district, keyed by the state district code, with the counties it serves. Board facts are null where not yet recorded; board members are not included.
updateCadence: Checked twice weekly; changes only when the registry does.
source: Georgia Civic Data districts dimension (georgiacivicdata.org, CC BY 4.0; GOSA district codes and the NCES Common Core of Data), with service counties checked against Georgia Department of Revenue millage reports and board facts recorded by a person
